recommendations.headline: Satisfaction, not price, is the real conversion lever — satisfied calls close at 72% versus 16% for neutral and only 5% for dissatisfied calls, yet 52% of calls stay neutral and 45% end as an open 'callback' because reps give slow/unclear answers (387 cases) and don't fix follow-up (373 cases) or ask for the order (218 cases).
behaviour: 45% of all calls (1069/2354) end as 'callback' rather than a decision, showing heavy stalling/indecision.
Price-shopping and quote comparison dominate behaviour (price_shopper 408, comparing_quotes 245) — buyers are actively benchmarking before committing.
Only 20% of calls convert to an order overall; dealers close at 41% (1140 calls) vs unidentified 'unknown' segment at just 25% (846 calls) — segment isn't being captured early.
Price is discussed in only 30% of calls (708/2354; 1646 'not_discussed') yet price_high is still the #1 objection (324 calls) — perception gap exists even without a quote.
Repeat (215) and bulk (213) buyers are common, but only 17 calls show explicit 'loyal_to_us' sentiment — loyalty is not being reinforced.
satisfaction: Call satisfaction directly drives sales: satisfied calls win 72%, neutral calls win only 16%, dissatisfied calls win just 5% (n=830/1222/201).
52% of calls (1222) are rated merely 'neutral' on satisfaction — the biggest single bucket, representing the largest untapped upside.
Only 11% of calls (264/2354) end with price simply 'accepted'; 16% go into negotiation and 3% are flatly rejected as too high — most price conversations are workable, not lost causes.
Top rep-side gaps are service quality issues, not pricing: slow/unclear answers (387) and no fixed follow-up (373) far outnumber pure price pushback (75 'too_high').

conversion.title: Fix the follow-up discipline
conversion.evidence: no_follow_up_fixed flagged in 373 calls; 45% of calls (1069) end as unresolved callback
conversion.action: Every call must end with a specific date/time for next contact logged in CRM; managers audit a sample weekly.

conversion.title: Always send a written quote in-call
conversion.evidence: no_quote_sent in 219 calls; price_enquiry is the top intent (799) but orders are only 463
conversion.action: Mandate WhatsApp/email quote sent before call ends for every price enquiry; track quote-sent rate as a KPI.

conversion.title: Train reps to explicitly ask for the order
conversion.evidence: didnt_ask_for_order flagged in 218 calls; order_pct is only 20%
conversion.action: Add a closing question ('Shall I confirm this order?') to the standard call script after every quote.

conversion.title: Speed up and standardise answers
conversion.evidence: slow_or_unclear_answer is the single largest rep miss (387 calls); satisfied calls win 72% vs 16% for neutral
conversion.action: Build a quick-reference rate/stock sheet (printed/app) so reps answer price, thickness and stock questions instantly without hold time.

conversion.title: Capture customer segment at call start
conversion.evidence: 'unknown' segment (846 calls) wins only 25% vs dealer 41%, builder/end_user 41%, contractor 36%
conversion.action: Require reps to tag caller type (dealer/contractor/fabricator/end_user) in the first minute and use the matching segment script.

conversion.title: Offer alternatives on stock-outs instead of a dead end
conversion.evidence: didnt_offer_alternative in 127 calls; stock_availability is the 2nd-biggest objection (321 calls, win 25%)
conversion.action: Maintain a live cross-brand/size substitute list so reps can propose an alternative on the same call.

conversion.title: Resolve credit-term requests proactively
conversion.evidence: credit_terms objection has the highest win rate among objections (29%, 70 calls) and needs_credit appears in 93 calls
conversion.action: Give reps a clear, simple credit-eligibility script for verified repeat dealers to unlock stalled deals.

offers.title: Instant WhatsApp quote service
offers.why: no_quote_sent flagged in 219 calls; faster quotes reduce quote-comparison leakage.

offers.title: Stock & rate update subscription
offers.why: fast_delivery (433) and stock_availability (431) are the top two stated needs; regular_updates also wanted by 198 customers.

offers.title: Pre-cut/processed sheet service
offers.for_whom: Fabricators and contractors ordering cut lengths
offers.why: cutting_processing need appears in 97 calls, concentrated among fabricator/contractor segments.

offers.title: Sample pack + test certificate on request
offers.why: quality_doubt is an objection in 91 calls; samples (58) and test_certificate (18) are explicit asks.

offers.title: Consider a short credit window for verified repeat dealers
offers.why: needs_credit appears in 93 calls and credit_terms objection has the highest win-rate (29%) once addressed.

offers.title: Scheduled delivery-window booking
offers.why: site_delivery need in 95 calls and delivery_time is the 3rd biggest objection (189 calls).

loyalty.title: Consider a recognition programme for repeat/bulk buyers
loyalty.how: Track repeat_buyer (215) and bulk_buyer (213) tags; reward with priority dispatch slots or appreciation certificates, not discounts
loyalty.why: Only 17 calls show explicit 'loyal_to_us' sentiment despite large repeat/bulk volumes — loyalty isn't being reinforced.

loyalty.title: Assign dedicated contact for top dealers
loyalty.how: Give high-volume dealers (41% win rate, 1140 calls) a named rep for continuity
loyalty.why: Dealers already convert best; a stable relationship can lift satisfaction further (satisfied calls win 72%).

loyalty.title: Formalise a referral acknowledgement
loyalty.how: Thank and flag referring customers with priority service/attention, tracked in CRM
loyalty.why: referral behaviour logged in only 26 calls — an easy, low-cost segment to nurture.

loyalty.title: Free technical advisory line
loyalty.how: Offer a quick call-back/WhatsApp line for site/technical queries separate from sales
loyalty.why: needs_technical_help (342) and technical_advice need (381) are among the highest-volume signals.

loyalty.title: Proactive status-update habit
loyalty.how: Rep sends automatic order/dispatch status update without customer having to call back
loyalty.why: regular_updates needed by 198 customers; no_follow_up_fixed flagged in 373 calls.

non_price_benefits.title: Fast delivery capability
non_price_benefits.why: fast_delivery is the top customer need (433 mentions).

non_price_benefits.title: Wide multi-brand stock (JSW, Pragathi, Radiance, Color On Plus etc.)
non_price_benefits.why: stock_availability is the 2nd top need (431) and also the 2nd top objection (321 calls).

non_price_benefits.title: In-house technical advice on thickness/sizing
non_price_benefits.why: technical_advice need (381) and needs_technical_help behaviour (342) are both high-frequency.

non_price_benefits.title: Authorised JSW distributor quality assurance
non_price_benefits.why: quality_doubt objection present in 91 calls; quality_assurance explicitly needed by 123 customers.

non_price_benefits.title: Consistent, reliable supply
non_price_benefits.why: consistent_supply need flagged in 119 calls, relevant against stock-related objections.

non_price_benefits.title: After-sales support and test certificates on request
non_price_benefits.why: after_sales_support (42) and test_certificate (18) needs, directly addressing quality concerns.

top_questions.question: What is the price for [product/size]?
top_questions.answer_tip: Use the quick rate reference sheet to answer instantly and follow up with a written quote in the same call.

top_questions.question: Is stock available for this item?
top_questions.answer_tip: Check live stock before answering; if unavailable, immediately offer the nearest brand/size alternative.

top_questions.question: When will the delivery vehicle arrive?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a specific time window and proactively message if the plan changes rather than waiting for the customer to call back.

top_questions.question: Can you reduce the price?
top_questions.answer_tip: Acknowledge the ask, then lead with value points (authorised distributor quality, delivery reliability, technical support) before discussing any flexibility within policy.

top_questions.question: Can we get credit terms or partial payment?
top_questions.answer_tip: Use a standard credit-eligibility script for verified repeat customers rather than an ad-hoc refusal.

top_questions.question: Why is the competitor cheaper?
top_questions.answer_tip: Reframe around quality assurance, consistent supply and after-sales support rather than matching price on the call.

top_questions.question: Why did the wrong color/size arrive?
top_questions.answer_tip: Apologise, confirm order details were correct at dispatch, and commit to a specific resolution timeline to rebuild satisfaction.

top_questions.question: Did you send the quotation/PO confirmation?
top_questions.answer_tip: Send it during the call itself and verbally confirm receipt before hanging up to avoid the 219-case 'no quote sent' gap.
